outline: Statics is the fundamental of other application subjects, including mechanisms, mechanical design, and mechatronic systems, etc.. The course introduces the following topics: Force Systems, Equilibrium, Structures, Distributed Forces, Centroids of Volumes and Mass, Momemts of Inertia, Analysis of Structures, Friction, and Virtual Work.
schedule:
Week 1：Course introduction, Vector composition/decomposition
Week 2：Force systems (2D)
Week 3：Force systems (3D)
Week 4：Mid-term exam I
Week 5：Equilibrium, Truss - Method of Joint
Week 6：Truss - Method of Joint, Method of Section
Week 7：Truss - Method of Section, Frame, Machine
Week 8：Mid-term exam II
Week 9：Centers of Lines, Areas, and Volumes
Week 10：Centroids and Moment of Inertia
Week 11：Mid-term exam III
Week 12：Distributed forces - Beams - External effects
Week 13：Distributed forces - Beams - Internal effects
Week 14：Cables
Week 15：Mid-term exam IV
Week 16：Friction
Week 17：Friction, Virtual work
Week 18：Final exam
